label: rem:spectator-normalization-remark
title: Origin and sign of the spectator normalization
html:
The spectator normalization captures the contribution of unchanged nucleons to the Q-value character sum. In a beta decay, one neutron converts to a proton. The remaining Z protons and N - 1 neutrons act as spectators.

Fermionic character. Both a < 0 and b < 0 for all q > 1. This negativity reflects the fermionic character of the nucleon. The sign of the spectator product is (-1)^{A-1}. This sign fixes the parity regime for the Q-value.
